perspective:
Seeker has access to:

- They greeted the recommender and asked how they were.
- They said they were looking for good action movies.
- The recommender asked whether they prefer hard core action or fun family action.
- They said they love both kinds, specifically naming *Abduction (2011)* and *Speed (1994)* with Keanu Reeves.
- The recommender suggested *Mad Max (1979)*.
- They said they liked that one but thought *Mad Max: Fury Road (2015)* with Tom Hardy was better.
- The recommender mentioned *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi (2017)* as popular.
- They said they could never get into the Star Wars movies.
- The recommender brought up *Die Hard (1988)* as a Christmas movie.
- They said that one with Bruce Willis is pretty good.
- The recommender mentioned *Jumanji (2017)* as one they saw that weekend.
- They asked for recommendations more along the lines of *The Taking of Pelham 123 (2009)* or *S.W.A.T. (2003)*, and asked whether the new one of “that movie” was good.
- The recommender answered, “it was fun!”
